meta.title: Translation priority — can hear it, no text found
meta.source: data/tables/people-group-pins.json — the same index the map draws, so this table and the map cannot disagree.
meta.definition: A people group with recorded audio, the JESUS Film, a Bible video or Words of Life in their language, and NO text Scripture found in the pools checked. "Not found" is a statement about those pools, never a claim that no text exists — several of the largest rows are varieties where a recording plainly exists and a text in that same variety is contested. The checked and unchecked pools are on every row for that reason.
